A.title: Lorentzian Hodge star and periods
A.statement: On oriented affine Minkowski space with eta=diag(-1,1,1,1) and vol=dx0 wedge dx1 wedge dx2 wedge dx3, define star by alpha wedge star beta=<alpha,beta>_eta vol using determinant-normalized exterior pairing. A.title: Local two-form potentials and global obstruction

A.statement: Let Omega be a bounded Lipschitz polyhedron. H(curl) is the L2 distributional-curl graph space; H0(curl) is the closure of compactly supported smooth vectors in this norm. B.physical_scope: Conditional classical Maxwell-Lorentz model, in the precise geometry, regularity, source and approximation regime stated; no empirical claim or quantization.
